dialogue.content: こんにちは。
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: 今回初めてこちらのロールプレイに参加させていただきます。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: This is my first time participating in this role-play. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: 手順は１４時になった時点で開始ということでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Regarding the procedure, is it alright if we begin at 2:00 p.m.?

dialogue.content: 初めてなのですね。肩の力抜いてやって行きましょう！今日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Oh, it's your first time? Let's relax and take it easy! I'm looking forward to working with you today.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. I look forward to working with you as well.

dialogue.content: ジャストで無くても大丈夫でしたら開始頂いて大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: If it's alright with you, we don't have to wait until the exact time. We can start whenever you're ready.

dialogue.content: 承知致しました。では、始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Understood. Then, let's begin.

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: お越しいただいてありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 友人から泥棒扱いされて傷ついてます
dialogue.English: I'm hurt because my friends treated me like a thief.

dialogue.content: それは悲しいですね。
dialogue.English: That must be very upsetting.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なぜそのようになったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me what led up to that?

dialogue.content: 友人5人で旅行に行ったのですか、3.2人で部屋が分かれ
dialogue.English: Five of us friends went on a trip, and we split into two rooms, one with three people and one with two.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 夜、トランプしに3人部屋で遊びました。翌日、集合しランチをしていた時
dialogue.English: At night, we went to the room with three people to play cards. The next day, when we all met up for lunch...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 1人の友人のお財布からお金が無くなってる。昨夜、部屋に来たのは貴方だから財布を見せろ。と3人に詰められました
dialogue.English: One of my friends said money was missing from her wallet. The three of them cornered me, saying, "You were the one who came to our room last night, so show us your wallet."

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それは傷つきますよね
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been very hurtful.

dialogue.content: はい、しかも
dialogue.English: Yes, and what's more...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Go ahead.

dialogue.content: お金が無くなった子は、親から新券で小遣い貰った。と、私も親から新券で貰ってたのです。あなたの財布に新券があったら犯人だと言われ焦りました
dialogue.English: The friend who lost the money had received their allowance in new bills from their parents, and I had also received new bills from my parents. They said that if there were new bills in my wallet, I must be the culprit, and I panicked.

dialogue.content: それは、とても辛い状況ですね。そのあとどうなったのですか？
dialogue.English: That sounds like a very difficult situation. What happened after that?

dialogue.content: 親友が、そこまでするのは酷すぎる！人としても有り得ない。と、止めてくれたので話題自体変わりました
dialogue.English: My best friend stepped in and stopped them, saying, "Going that far is too cruel! That's just unacceptable as a person." So the topic changed.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。その親友の方がいてくれて救われましたよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It must have been a relief to have your best friend there for you.

dialogue.content: はい、とっても
dialogue.English: Yes, very much so.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。でも友達にそんなふうに言われたらショックでしたよね
dialogue.English: I can imagine. But it must have been a shock to be told something like that by your friends.

dialogue.content: 傷つきから立ち直れてません
dialogue.English: I haven't been able to get over the hurt.

dialogue.content: そうですよね友達に疑われて、とても辛いことだったと思います。
dialogue.English: I understand. Being suspected by your friends must have been incredibly painful.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: とても辛いお気持ちをお話しして下さりありがとうございます。このままもう少しお話し伺ってもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing such painful feelings with me. Is it alright if we continue talking about this a little longer?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。お友達とはどんな関係なんですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What is your relationship with these friends like?

dialogue.content: 高校のクラスメイトで、親友は中学の時からの付き合いです
dialogue.English: They are my high school classmates, and my best friend and I have known each other since middle school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。親友の方とは長いお付き合いなのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you and your best friend have known each other for a long time.

dialogue.content: 6年目になります
dialogue.English: This is our sixth year.

dialogue.content: それは長いですね！すてきな関係なのかなと思いましたが、親友の方はあなたにとってどんな方ですか？
dialogue.English: That's a long time! It sounds like a wonderful relationship. What kind of person is your best friend to you?

dialogue.content: 財産です
dialogue.English: They're a treasure to me.

dialogue.content: 財産！とっても素敵ですね！
dialogue.English: A treasure! That's a wonderful way to put it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 他の３人のお友達とはどんな関係ですか？
dialogue.English: What is your relationship with the other three friends?

dialogue.content: ただのクラスメイトで私はあまり繋がりは無いですが、親友は仲が良いようで。
dialogue.English: They're just classmates, and I'm not that close to them, but my best friend seems to be good friends with them.

dialogue.content: なるほど、親友の方のつながりで、今回一緒に旅行に行かれたんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you went on this trip together because of your best friend's connection to them.

dialogue.content: はい、ただ今回の事で親友も3人との縁を切りました
dialogue.English: Yes, but because of this incident, my best friend has cut ties with the three of them.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね親友の方もあなたのことがとっても大切なんですね
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you are very important to your best friend.

dialogue.content: そう思って貰えてるとは思いますが、3人の行動が許せない。と言ってました
dialogue.English: I think they feel that way, but they said they couldn't forgive what the other three did.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。きっと親友の方にとってもあなたのことをかけがえのない存在だと思っているから、友人の行動を許せないと思うんですよね
dialogue.English: I understand. I'm sure your best friend sees you as an irreplaceable person, and that's why she can't forgive their actions.

dialogue.content: ええ…ただ、私は盗んでいないので結局誰が犯人なのか？又は作り話しの虐めなのか？色々、考えてもしまってます
dialogue.English: Yes... But since I didn't steal it, I keep thinking about who the real culprit is, or if this was all just a made-up story to bully me.

dialogue.content: 親友も
dialogue.English: My best friend too...

dialogue.content: なるほどでは、財布は見つかっていない状態なんですね。そうですよね、いろいろ考えてしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I see, so the money hasn't been found. Of course, you would be thinking about all sorts of possibilities.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私をただかばった。と言うより正義感の強い子なので、3人がそう言う行動をする子達とは思ってなく裏切られた感じて許せない。と
dialogue.English: It's less that she was just defending me, and more that she has a strong sense of justice. She said she never thought those three were the kind of people to do something like that, so she felt betrayed and couldn't forgive them.

dialogue.content: 財布ごと無くなった訳で無く1万が無くなった。との事です
dialogue.English: It wasn't that the whole wallet was gone, just 10,000 yen.

dialogue.content: なるほど親友は正義感の強い方なんですね！それは許せないって思いますよね
dialogue.English: I see, so your best friend has a strong sense of justice. It's understandable that she would feel it's unforgivable.

dialogue.content: 中身のお金だけなくなったんですねそれは不思議ですね
dialogue.English: So only the money inside disappeared. That is strange.

dialogue.content: 話し合いや、報告では無くいきなり財布をみせろはあり得ない！と
dialogue.English: She said, "It's unacceptable to just demand to see a wallet without any discussion or explanation!"

dialogue.content: ええ、だから
dialogue.English: Yes, so...

dialogue.content: 確かにそうですよねあなたは友人の行動にどんなふうに思っていますか？
dialogue.English: That's certainly true. How do you feel about your friends' actions?

dialogue.content: 私を落とし入れるイジメなのか？取られた子のウソなのか。ただ、新券にこだわってたのも本当だからなのか、私が新券を持ってるのを知っての事なのか…訳がわからなく
dialogue.English: Is it bullying intended to set me up? Is the person who said their money was taken lying? Or were they fixated on the new bills because that part is true—did they know I had new bills? I just can't make sense of it.

dialogue.content: 私も、相談？事実報告の上の話し合いが無いのは傷つきました
dialogue.English: I was also hurt that there was no discussion, no attempt to talk about it or report the facts first.

dialogue.content: そのように感じているんですねいろんなことグルグル考えてしまいますよねなにも言われずいきなりこられたら、やはりショックだし傷つきますよね
dialogue.English: That's how you're feeling. I can see how your mind would be spinning with all these thoughts. Being confronted like that out of the blue, without any explanation, would naturally be shocking and hurtful.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。今あなたはその友人とはどんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. How are things between you and those friends now?

dialogue.content: 話しもしてません向こうも避けてる様です
dialogue.English: We haven't spoken, and it seems they're avoiding me too.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねそんなことがあったら当然ですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That's understandable after something like that.

dialogue.content: 謝罪は欲しいですが、向こうにしたらまだ疑ってるのか、イジメを諦めたのか…分からないです
dialogue.English: I do want an apology, but I don't know whether they still suspect me or have given up on bullying me.

dialogue.content: うんうん、謝罪は欲しいですよねただ、相手がどう思っているのかわからないですよね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, it's natural to want an apology. It's just that you don't know what they're thinking.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうですよねじゃあこれからどうしたらいいか一緒に考えていきましょう
dialogue.English: Right. Then let's think together about what to do from here.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今までのお話をまとめると
dialogue.English: To summarize what we've talked about so far...

dialogue.content: あなたは友人に泥棒扱いされ、その場は親友に助けてもらったが、その時の傷が癒えずにいる
dialogue.English: You were treated like a thief by your friends, and your best friend helped you in the moment, but the wound from that hasn't healed.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その友人とはその後お互いに避けていて、話はしていない。謝罪が欲しいが、相手はどう思っているかわからない
dialogue.English: Since then, you and those friends have been avoiding each other and haven't spoken. You want an apology, but you don't know what they're thinking.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ＊すみません時間が過ぎてしまったのですが、この場合はこのまま続けていいのでしょうか？最後まで？
dialogue.English: *Excuse me, I see we've gone over our time. In this case, should we continue as we are? Until the end?

dialogue.content: （私は15時20分位まででしたら大丈夫ですので、もう少しつづけましょうか？）
dialogue.English: (I'm available until about 3:20 PM, so shall we continue a little longer?)

dialogue.content: （出来る所まで）
dialogue.English: (As far as we can.)

dialogue.content: ＊承知致しました。では続けさせていただきます
dialogue.English: *Understood. Then let's continue.

dialogue.content: （はい、よろしくお願いいたします）
dialogue.English: (Yes, please.)

dialogue.content: 友人とは同じクラスメイトということでしたが、ほかの２人のかたとも今はお話しなどもされていないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned that they are your classmates. Are you not speaking with any of the three of them now?

dialogue.content: 3人ともクラスメイトですが、話しはしてません
dialogue.English: All three of them are classmates, but I'm not talking to them.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。そんなことがあってからだと気まずいところはありますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It must be awkward after what happened.

dialogue.content: 向こうが何を考えてるのか不気味です
dialogue.English: It's unsettling not knowing what they are thinking.

dialogue.content: 不気味なんですね。そうですよね、誤解したままだとお互いにモヤモヤした部分が残ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: Unsettling. I can see that. When there's a misunderstanding, it can leave both sides with lingering, unresolved feelings.

dialogue.content: お互い…そうですよね、向こうにしたら私が犯人とまだ疑っている思いもあるんですよね
dialogue.English: Both sides... you're right. From their perspective, they might still suspect me of being the culprit.

dialogue.content: 相手が何を考えているかは本人にしかわからないですよね。あなたは何も悪いことはしていない。それは事実じゃないですか！
dialogue.English: Only they know what they're really thinking. You haven't done anything wrong. That's a fact, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですよね…はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: You're right... Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: ええそこは胸張っていいと思いますよ！あなたはとっても人を想う優しい方なので、相手の方のことを考えてしまっているんですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, you can hold your head high about that! You are a very kind and considerate person, which is why you're thinking so much about how the others might feel.

dialogue.content: いえ、自分の傷つきの事でいっぱいでしたが、相手も本当にお金が無くなり凄く困って必死だったのかも知れないです
dialogue.English: No, I've just been so preoccupied with my own hurt, but maybe they were genuinely in trouble and desperate because they really did lose their money.

dialogue.content: 勇気を出して
dialogue.English: I'll gather my courage and...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 話し合って見たいと思えました
dialogue.English: I've come to feel I'd like to try to talk it through.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね！とってもいいと思います！
dialogue.English: You do? I think that's a wonderful idea!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！相談に来て良かったです頑張ってみます
dialogue.English: Thank you so much! I'm glad I came to talk to you. I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: （終結まで行けましたね。素晴らしいカウンセリングありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (We were able to reach closure. Thank you for the wonderful counseling.)

dialogue.content: ＊勇気づけの言葉までいけなかったです。すみません
dialogue.English: *I wasn't able to get as far as offering words of encouragement. I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: （本当に出会えて良かったです。又、お会いした時はよろしくお願いいたします）
dialogue.English: (I'm truly glad we had this session. I look forward to seeing you again.)

dialogue.content: ＊お時間ギリギリまでお付き合いいただいてありがとうございました
dialogue.English: *Thank you for staying with me right up to the end of our time.

dialogue.content: ＊はい！こちらこそ勉強させて頂きました。ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: *Yes! Thank you, this was a great learning experience for me as well. Thank you.

dialogue.content: （こちらこそありがとうございました。お疲れさまでした。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well. Thank you for your hard work.)

dialogue.content: では終了とさせていただきます
dialogue.English: Then let's conclude the session.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.
